questions.q: A 6 x 7 sparse matrix has 5 non-zero elements. How many cells does its triplet (row, column, value) representation need, including the header row?
questions.exp: Triplet form has (t + 1) rows of 3 values: (5 + 1) x 3 = 18 cells, against 42 cells for the full matrix.

questions.q: The Harvard architecture, used by the 8051, PIC and AVR families, has
options: one common memory for program and data
separate memories and buses for program and data
only a cache and no main memory
questions.exp: Harvard architecture keeps program and data in separate memories, allowing simultaneous fetch of instruction and data; von Neumann uses a single memory.

questions.q: In the Critical Path Method (CPM) of project scheduling, the critical path is
options: The shortest path from start to end
The longest path from start to end of the activity network
The path having the largest number of activities
The path having the maximum slack
questions.exp: The critical path is the longest duration path; it has zero slack and determines the minimum project duration.

questions.q: In the URL https://www.example.com:8080/docs/index.html?id=5#top, which part is the query string?
questions.exp: The query string follows '?' and precedes '#'; here it is id=5.

questions.q: Selection sort is used to sort 10 elements. Exactly how many comparisons does it make?
questions.exp: Selection sort always does (n-1)+(n-2)+...+1 = n(n-1)/2 = 45 comparisons.
f is virtual, so the call through the base pointer is bound at run time to B::f.

questions.q: Using vibration and temperature sensors on factory machines to forecast a failure before it occurs is called:
questions.exp: Predictive maintenance is a flagship IIoT application: sensor data is analysed to predict faults and schedule repair.

questions.q: A 16-bit instruction has a 4-bit opcode and three register address fields of equal size. How many registers can each field address?
questions.exp: Remaining bits = 12, so each field has 4 bits and can address 2⁴ = 16 registers.

questions.q: In a stop-and-wait protocol, a link has 1 Mbps bandwidth, frames of 1000 bits and one-way propagation delay of 4 ms. What is the link utilization?
questions.exp: Tt = 1 ms, Tp = 4 ms. Utilization = Tt/(Tt + 2Tp) = 1/9 ≈ 11.1%.

questions.q: Which keyword is used in Java to inherit a class from another class?
questions.exp: A class inherits another class using extends; implements is used for interfaces.

questions.q: The disk head is at cylinder 50. The request queue (in arrival order) is 82, 170, 43, 140, 24, 16, 190. What is the total head movement under FCFS?
A static member function in C++ can directly access:
options: Only static data members and other static member functions
questions.exp: A static function belongs to the class, has no this pointer, and so can directly use only static members.

questions.q:
What is the value of x after the statement?
int x = 2 + 3 * 4 % 5;
questions.exp: *, % have higher precedence than + and associate left to right: 3*4 = 12, 12%5 = 2, then 2 + 2 = 4.

questions.q:
Statement I: The finally block of a try statement executes whether or not an exception occurs.
Statement II: The else block of a try statement executes only when an exception is raised in the try block.
Which is correct?
options: Statement I is true and Statement II is false
Statement I is false and Statement II is true
questions.exp: finally always runs; else runs only when the try block completes without an exception.
A static local variable is initialised only once and keeps its value between calls, so it prints 1 2 3.

questions.q: Non-preemptive SJF: P1 (arrival 0, burst 7), P2 (2, 4), P3 (4, 1), P4 (5, 4). What is the average waiting time?
For the pattern 'abcabcab', the last entry of the KMP prefix (failure) function is
questions.exp: The longest proper prefix of 'abcabcab' that is also a suffix is 'abcab', of length 5.

questions.q: Which is the correct way to start a function template declaration in C++?
questions.exp: Function templates begin with template <class T> (or template <typename T>) before the function.

questions.q: A data hazard in which an instruction tries to read a register before a previous instruction has written its result is called
questions.exp: This is Read After Write (RAW), a true data dependence.

questions.q: A system has a 64 KB logical address space, 1 KB pages and 32 KB of physical memory. How many frames are there in physical memory?
questions.exp: Number of frames = 32 KB / 1 KB = 32.

questions.q: Relation R(A, B, C, D) has the functional dependencies AB → CD and C → A. How many candidate keys does R have?
questions.exp: B is on no right side so it is in every key. AB is a key, and since C → A, BC also determines A and hence everything. A+ = A and B+ = B, so the keys are AB and BC: 2.

questions.q: A queue is initially empty. The operations performed are: enqueue(1), enqueue(2), enqueue(3), dequeue, enqueue(4), dequeue, enqueue(5). Which element is now at the front?
questions.exp: After enqueues 1,2,3 and a dequeue the queue is 2,3; add 4 then dequeue removes 2 giving 3,4; adding 5 gives 3,4,5. Front is 3.

questions.q: Facts: P, Q. Rules: R1: P AND Q → R; R2: R → S; R3: S AND T → U. Forward chaining finally derives which set of facts?
questions.exp: R1 gives R, R2 gives S; R3 needs T which is unknown, so U is never derived.

questions.q: The Held-Karp dynamic programming algorithm solves the Travelling Salesman Problem for n cities in time
questions.exp: There are n·2ⁿ subproblems (subset, last city) each taking O(n) to compute, giving O(n² 2ⁿ).

questions.q: Two operations from different transactions are in conflict when they access the same data item and at least one is a write. Which pair is in conflict?
questions.exp: W1(X) and R2(X) are on the same item X, from different transactions, and one is a write, so they conflict. The others lack one of these conditions.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
print(2 + 3 * 4 ** 2 // 5 % 4)
What is the default TCP port used by an MQTT broker for unencrypted connections?
questions.exp: MQTT uses port 1883 for plain connections; 8883 is used for MQTT over TLS, and 5683 is the CoAP UDP port.

questions.q: Which type of interrupt cannot be disabled (masked) by the processor?
questions.exp: A non-maskable interrupt (NMI) is always serviced; used for critical events such as power failure.
Strings are immutable; concat returns a new String that is discarded, so s remains Hi.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a property of a cryptographic hash function?
options: It must be possible to recover the original message from its hash
It produces a fixed-length output for any input size
It is hard to find two inputs with the same hash
A tiny change in input changes the output drastically
questions.exp: Hash functions are one-way; reversibility would defeat their purpose.

questions.q: Node.js is best described as:
options: a JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine that runs JavaScript outside the browser
a CSS framework for responsive layouts
questions.exp: Node.js is a server-side JavaScript runtime (V8) with event-driven, non-blocking I/O; it is neither a language nor a database.

questions.q: What is the default port number of HTTPS?
questions.exp: HTTPS uses TCP port 443 by default; HTTP uses 80.

questions.q: A 1500-byte packet is sent over a 10 Mbps link. What is the transmission delay?
questions.exp: Transmission delay = 1500 × 8 bits / 10⁷ bps = 12000 / 10⁷ = 1.2 ms.

questions.q: Which of the following is a lossless data compression technique?
questions.exp: Huffman coding (like RLE and LZW) lets the original data be recovered exactly. JPEG, MP3 and MPEG discard information and are lossy.

questions.q: The IP address 172.20.5.9 belongs to which class?
questions.exp: Class B addresses have first octet in the range 128–191; 172 lies in this range.

questions.q: Which of the following is a valid JSON object?
questions.exp: JSON requires double-quoted keys and strings and does not allow trailing commas.

questions.q: What is the number of states in the minimal DFA over {0,1} that accepts all strings in which the number of 0s is divisible by 3?
questions.exp: Only the count of 0s modulo 3 matters, giving three equivalence classes: 0, 1, 2.

questions.q: The 8-bit 2's complement representation of -37 is
Which 8085 instruction loads the accumulator from a memory location whose 16-bit address is given directly in the instruction?
questions.exp: LDA addr (direct addressing, 3 bytes) copies the byte at the given address into A.
C.__init__ first calls the parent constructor through super() (prints P) and then prints C.

questions.q: A differential backup copies
options: Only files changed since the most recent backup of any type
All files changed since the last full backup
Only the files deleted since the last full backup
questions.exp: Differential backups grow each day because they always compare against the last full backup.

questions.q: An e-mail that appears to come from a bank asks the user to click a link and enter net-banking credentials on a look-alike page. This attack is called
questions.exp: Tricking users via deceptive messages into revealing credentials on fake sites is phishing.

questions.q: How many 16-bit timer/counters are available in the standard 8051?
questions.exp: The 8051 has Timer 0 and Timer 1; the 8052 adds Timer 2.

questions.q: Which of the following decision problems is NP-complete?
options: Single-source shortest path with non-negative weights
Searching a key in a sorted array
questions.exp: Hamiltonian cycle is a classic NP-complete problem; the others are solvable in polynomial time.

questions.q: Which of the following context-free languages cannot be accepted by any deterministic PDA?
questions.exp: For w w^R the machine must guess the middle of the string, which needs nondeterminism; the others have a marker or fixed structure.

questions.q: What is the maximum channel utilization (throughput) of pure ALOHA?
questions.exp: Pure ALOHA maximum throughput is 1/(2e) ≈ 0.184, i.e. 18.4%.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a function of the control unit?
questions.exp: Arithmetic and logic operations are done by the ALU; the control unit only fetches, decodes and sequences operations.

questions.q: What is the worst-case time complexity of searching for a key in a binary search tree of n nodes that has become completely skewed?
questions.exp: A skewed BST degenerates into a linked list of height n-1, so search may visit all n nodes.
a ^ b is the symmetric difference {1,2,5}; the union {1,2,3,4,5} has 5 elements.

questions.q: Which class of the java.io package is designed to read a text file as a stream of characters?
questions.exp: FileReader reads characters; FileInputStream reads raw bytes, FileWriter writes characters and PrintStream is an output stream.

questions.q: The "zero trust" security model is based on the principle
options: trust everything inside the corporate network
trust any user with a valid IP address
never trust, always verify every access request
trust devices that were once authenticated forever
questions.exp: Zero trust authenticates and authorises each request regardless of network location.

questions.q: In the A* search algorithm, the evaluation function for a node n is
questions.exp: A* uses f(n) = g(n) + h(n), the cost so far plus the estimated cost to the goal.

questions.q: Direct Memory Access (DMA) is used to:
options: transfer blocks of data between a device and memory without CPU involvement for each byte
increase the clock speed of the CPU
questions.exp: The DMA controller moves data directly and interrupts the CPU only after the whole transfer finishes.

questions.q: The Singleton design pattern is used to:
options: create objects without specifying their exact class
add behaviour to an object dynamically
ensure a class has only one instance with a global access point
questions.exp: Singleton is a creational pattern restricting a class to one instance. Factory creates objects without naming the class, Decorator adds behaviour, Observer notifies dependents.
Two successive forks create 2² = 4 processes, and each prints A once.

questions.q: The degree of membership of an element in a fuzzy set always lies in the range
questions.exp: A fuzzy membership function maps elements to real values between 0 and 1 inclusive; {0,1} is the crisp case.

questions.q: The minimum number of 4:1 multiplexers needed to construct a 16:1 multiplexer is
questions.exp: Four 4:1 MUXes in the first stage choose among the 16 inputs in groups of 4, and one more 4:1 MUX selects among their outputs: 4 + 1 = 5.

questions.q: Which of the following languages over {a, b} is regular?
questions.exp: a^i b^j with independent i and j is described by a*b*; the others need unbounded counting or matching.

questions.q: Strassen's matrix multiplication algorithm multiplies two n × n matrices in time
questions.exp: Strassen uses 7 recursive multiplications: T(n) = 7T(n/2) + Θ(n²) = Θ(n^log₂7).

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a constraint of the REST architectural style?
questions.exp: REST requires statelessness: each request carries all needed information, so server-side session state is not part of REST.

questions.q: In the three-level (ANSI-SPARC) architecture, the level that describes only the part of the database relevant to a particular group of users is the
options: storage level of the operating system
questions.exp: The external level contains many user views, each showing only the data of interest to one user group; the conceptual level gives the whole logical design and the internal level the physical storage.

questions.q: The 8086 has 20 address lines. Its physical memory space is therefore
Which relational algebra operation is naturally used to answer 'find students who have enrolled in ALL courses offered by the department'?
questions.exp: Division (R ÷ S) returns values of one attribute that are associated with every tuple of S, matching 'for all' queries.

questions.q: In a NOR-based SR latch, which input combination is forbidden (leads to an invalid state)?
questions.exp: With S = R = 1 both NOR outputs are forced to 0, so Q and Q' are equal, and the next state is unpredictable when both return to 0.

questions.q: Which statement correctly describes AES?
questions.exp: AES (Rijndael) works on 128-bit blocks and supports key lengths of 128, 192 and 256 bits.

questions.q: The minimum number of flip-flops required to build a mod-50 counter is
questions.exp: 2⁵ = 32 < 50 ≤ 64 = 2⁶, so 6 flip-flops are needed.

questions.q: For R(A, B, C, D, E) with F = {A → B, BC → D, D → E, E → A}, the closure {D}+ is
questions.exp: D → E, E → A, A → B gives {D, E, A, B}. C cannot be derived, so BC → D is not triggered and closure is {A, B, D, E}.

questions.q: Which generation of mobile networks first introduced digital voice transmission (GSM) and SMS text messaging?
questions.exp: 1G was analog; 2G made voice digital and introduced SMS.

questions.q: Type-1 (context-sensitive) grammars are recognized by which machine?
options: Turing machine with unbounded extra tape only
questions.exp: Context-sensitive languages are exactly those accepted by nondeterministic linear bounded automata.

questions.q: A tyre manufacturer sells directly through its web portal to car-making companies. Which e-commerce model does this represent?
questions.exp: Business selling to another business is B2B.

questions.q: What does malloc() return when it cannot allocate the requested memory?
questions.exp: malloc returns a NULL pointer on failure, so the result should always be checked before use.

questions.q: The preorder traversal of a binary tree is A B D E C F and the inorder traversal is D B E A F C. What is its postorder traversal?
options: D E B C F A
D B E F C A
D E B F C A
F D E B C A
questions.exp: A is the root; B(D,E) is the left subtree and C with left child F is the right subtree. Postorder = D E B F C A.

questions.q: The memory allocated to a union variable in C is equal to
options: the sum of the sizes of all its members
the size of its smallest member
the size of its largest member (with possible padding)
the product of the sizes of its members
questions.exp: All members of a union share the same memory, so the space needed is that of the largest member.

questions.q: For quick sort that always uses the first element as pivot, which input gives the worst case O(n²)?
options: An array already sorted in ascending order
An array in which every partition splits into equal halves
A randomly shuffled array of distinct keys
An array in which the first element is always the median of its subarray
questions.exp: With sorted input the first element is the minimum, so partitions are of size 0 and n−1 each time, giving T(n) = T(n−1) + n.

questions.q: A counting semaphore is initialised to 10. Then 14 P (wait) operations and 9 V (signal) operations are completed on it. What is the final value of the semaphore?
questions.exp: Final value = 10 - 14 + 9 = 5.

questions.q: Which of the following activities is an example of preventive maintenance?
options: Restructuring and refactoring code to reduce future maintenance problems
Fixing a crash reported by a user
Porting the software to a new operating system
Adding a new report requested by the client
questions.exp: Preventive maintenance improves the internal structure (e.g., refactoring) to avoid future problems; the other options are corrective, adaptive and perfective.

questions.q: Edges are listed in the order s->a 4, s->b 5, a->b -3, b->c 2 with source s. In the first pass of Bellman-Ford (relaxing the edges in this order), what is the value of d[c] at the end of the pass?
questions.exp: a = 4; b = 5 then 4 - 3 = 1; c = 1 + 2 = 3. Within one pass the updates propagate along the listed order.

questions.q: Data redundancy, data inconsistency and difficulty in concurrent access are typical problems of
questions.exp: Traditional file systems keep separate files per application, causing duplicated data, inconsistencies and poor concurrency control, which a DBMS is designed to solve.

questions.q:
Table Stu(name, marks): (A,40), (B,60), (C,80), (D,60). What does this query return?
SELECT name FROM Stu WHERE marks > (SELECT AVG(marks) FROM Stu);
questions.exp: AVG = (40+60+80+60)/4 = 60. Only marks strictly greater than 60 qualify, which is C (80).

questions.q: In the I/O-mapped I/O scheme of the 8085, how many input ports can be addressed?
questions.exp: IN and OUT instructions carry an 8-bit port address, so 2^8 = 256 input ports (and 256 output ports) are possible.

questions.q: Which logic family is the fastest because its transistors operate in the non-saturated (current-steering) region?
questions.exp: Emitter-coupled logic never saturates its transistors, so its propagation delay is below 1 ns; the price is high power dissipation and low noise margin.

questions.q: In a grammar in Greibach normal form, a string of length 6 is derived in exactly how many steps?
questions.exp: Every GNF production emits one terminal, so n steps for a string of length n (CNF needs 2n - 1).

questions.q: In a Hamming error-correcting code, the parity check bits are placed at bit positions
options: the last p positions of the word
questions.exp: Check bit P(2^k) at position 2^k covers all positions whose binary representation has bit k set; the syndrome then gives the error position.

questions.q: What does document.getElementById("abc") return if no element has the id "abc"?
questions.exp: getElementById returns null when no matching element exists.

questions.q: The postfix form of the infix expression (A+B)*C-D/E is
questions.exp: (A+B) gives AB+; times C gives AB+C*; D/E gives DE/; subtraction gives AB+C*DE/-.

questions.q: In Bresenham's line algorithm, the initial decision parameter is p0 = 2Δy − Δx. For a line from (0, 0) to (10, 4), what is p0?
By De Morgan's theorem, the complement of the function AB + C is
Which of the following languages is NOT regular?
options: strings over {a,b} with an even number of a's
questions.exp: a^n b^n requires unbounded counting, which a finite automaton cannot do; the pumping lemma shows it is not regular.

questions.q: What makes the blocks in a blockchain linked together and the chain tamper-evident?
options: Each block stores the IP address of its miner
Each block stores the private key of the sender
Each block stores the hash of the previous block
Each block stores a timestamp of the next block
questions.exp: Changing any block alters its hash and breaks the previous-hash link stored in the next block.

questions.q: A program flow graph has 14 edges and 11 nodes and is a single connected graph. What is its cyclomatic complexity V(G)?
In a batch operating system:
options: similar jobs are collected and executed together with no user interaction during execution
users interact with every job through terminals in real time
the CPU is shared in equal time slices among users
questions.exp: Batch systems group jobs with similar needs and run them sequentially without interaction.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following code?
t = (1, 2, [3, 4])
t[2].append(5)
print(t, len(t))
questions.exp: The tuple itself is not changed but the list inside it is mutable; length stays 3.

questions.q: A weak entity set
options: is identified by a partial key (discriminator) together with the primary key of its owner entity
has a primary key made of its own attributes only
can exist without any relationship to another entity set
questions.exp: A weak entity lacks a full key of its own; its discriminator combined with the owner's key identifies it.

questions.q: Which network device forwards frames to a specific port by learning MAC addresses?
questions.exp: A layer-2 switch maintains a MAC address table and forwards frames only to the port of the destination.

questions.q: Temporal locality of reference means that
options: A recently accessed item is likely to be accessed again soon
Items near a recently accessed item are likely to be accessed soon
Programs access memory only in sequential order
Data is always stored in sorted order
questions.exp: Temporal locality is re-use of the same item in a short time; the nearby-item case is spatial locality.

questions.q: Which of the following is true for an abstract class in Java?
options: It can contain both abstract and concrete methods but cannot be instantiated
It cannot contain any concrete method
It can be instantiated using new
questions.exp: An abstract class may mix abstract and implemented methods, but objects cannot be created from it directly.

questions.q: Two polynomials with 4 and 6 non-zero terms are added by merging their sorted linked lists. What is the maximum number of terms in the sum?
questions.exp: Merging produces at most m + n = 4 + 6 = 10 terms (fewer if exponents coincide); the merge itself takes O(m + n) time.

questions.q: In a two-level directory structure, file-name collisions between different users are avoided because:
options: each user has a separate User File Directory under a Master File Directory
all file names must be unique across the whole system
only absolute path names are allowed
questions.exp: The Master File Directory (MFD) points to a User File Directory (UFD) per user, so two users can each have a file with the same name. Name collision remains possible only within one user.

questions.q: Which philosophy considers self-realisation as the aim of education?
questions.exp: Idealists such as Plato hold that education leads to realising the spiritual self.

questions.q: The reliability of a test refers to:
options: the consistency of the test scores
questions.exp: A reliable test gives similar results on repeated administration.

questions.q: Which statement correctly distinguishes development from growth?
options: Growth continues throughout life while development stops at adolescence
Growth is psychological and development is only physical
Development is a continuous, progressive and qualitative change, while growth is mostly quantitative
Both terms mean exactly the same thing
questions.exp: Development includes qualitative and functional changes and continues lifelong; growth is structural and often stops at maturity.

questions.q: The highest need in Maslow's hierarchy is
questions.exp: Self-actualisation means realising one's full potential.

questions.q: Which of the following is the last step of the Herbartian plan?
questions.exp: Learners apply the generalised rule to new situations at the end.

questions.q: In education, action research was popularised by:
questions.exp: Corey applied action research to improve school practices.

questions.q: In Pavlov's experiment, food is the
questions.exp: Food naturally causes salivation without learning.

questions.q: The hidden curriculum refers to:
options: the syllabus printed in the textbook
unplanned values and attitudes learnt through school life and culture
questions.exp: Hidden curriculum is learned implicitly from the school environment and teacher behaviour.

questions.q: How many levels and stages does Kohlberg's theory have?
questions.exp: Preconventional, conventional and postconventional levels, each with two stages, make six stages.

questions.q: Summative assessment is mainly used to:
options: judge the overall achievement at the end of a course
questions.exp: It is used for grading, certification and promotion.

questions.q: 'Unplugged' activities in computer science teaching are:
options: activities done only on the internet
activities that teach computing concepts without using computers
questions.exp: Examples include sorting with cards or searching games.

questions.q: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act came into force on
questions.exp: The Act was passed in 2009 and came into force on 1 April 2010.

questions.q: Which of the following is a purely audio aid?
questions.exp: Radio gives only sound; film combines sound and picture.

questions.q: The term 'scaffolding' in teaching means
options: keeping students in groups by ability
giving temporary support that is gradually withdrawn as the learner becomes competent
questions.exp: Scaffolding is adjustable support within the ZPD, later removed as skill grows.

questions.q: The full form of MOOC is:
questions.exp: MOOCs are open-access online courses for large-scale participation.

questions.q: A major limitation of essay-type questions is:
options: they cannot test organisation of ideas
questions.exp: Different examiners may give different marks to the same answer.

questions.q: In the 5+3+3+4 structure, the 'foundational stage' lasts for:
questions.exp: It includes three years of pre-school and Grades 1 and 2.

questions.q: The major weakness of the lecture method is that:
questions.exp: The lecture method is teacher-centred and gives little scope for learner activity.

questions.q: The four main components of creativity measured by Torrance are
questions.exp: These are the standard components in the Torrance tests.

questions.q: Kounin's concept of 'withitness' means the teacher
options: is aware of what is happening in all parts of the classroom
questions.exp: Withitness shows students that the teacher knows what is going on.

questions.q: Professional ethics requires a teacher to:
options: share marks publicly to shame students
discuss students' family problems with strangers
questions.exp: Confidentiality respects the dignity and privacy of students.

questions.q: How many stages does Erikson's theory have?
questions.exp: Erikson proposed eight stages from infancy to old age.

questions.q: The Wardha Scheme of Basic Education (Nai Talim) was proposed by
questions.exp: Gandhi launched Nai Talim at the Wardha conference in 1937.

questions.q: The maxim 'from concrete to abstract' in teaching means that a teacher should:
options: begin with definitions and later show examples
begin with real objects or examples before introducing ideas and symbols
teach only the abstract part of every topic
avoid examples when the topic is difficult
questions.exp: Learners grasp ideas more easily when they first see or handle concrete things.

questions.q: A baby searches for a toy that has been covered with a cloth. The baby has acquired
questions.exp: Object permanence, knowing that things exist when out of sight, develops late in the sensorimotor stage.

questions.q: A typical microteaching lesson lasts about:
options: 5 to 10 minutes with a small group of students
40 to 45 minutes with a full class
questions.exp: Microteaching scales down time, class size and content.

questions.q: Thorndike's experiments with a cat in a puzzle box led to the theory of
questions.exp: The cat gradually reduced errors through repeated trials, reflecting trial-and-error (connectionism).

questions.q: A child of chronological age 10 years has a mental age of 12 years. The IQ is
'Education is the manifestation of the perfection already in man' is a statement of
questions.exp: This is Vivekananda's best-known definition of education.

questions.q: Remedial teaching is given to:
options: students having specific learning difficulties identified through diagnosis
every student at the same time without need
questions.exp: It is corrective instruction targeted at diagnosed difficulties.

questions.q: The slogan 'Do or Die' was given by which leader during the Quit India Movement of 1942?
questions.exp: Gandhi gave the call 'Do or Die' at Gowalia Tank Maidan, Bombay, on 8 August 1942.

questions.q: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.exp: It passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram - 8 states.

questions.q: The festival Chhath, widely celebrated in Bihar, is dedicated to which deity?
questions.exp: Chhath Puja is a four-day festival in which the Sun god Surya and Chhathi Maiya are worshipped.

questions.q: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.exp: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee; Rajendra Prasad presided over the Constituent Assembly.

questions.q:
Match the institution with its year of establishment.
P. Reserve Bank of India   Q. NABARD   R. Planning Commission
1. 1982   2. 1950   3. 1935
questions.exp: RBI was set up in 1935, NABARD in 1982 and the Planning Commission in 1950.

questions.q: The Wildlife (Protection) Act of India was enacted in the year
questions.exp: The Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 provides for protection of wild animals, birds and plants.

questions.q: Ozone layer, which absorbs harmful ultraviolet rays, is present in which layer of the atmosphere?
questions.exp: About 90% of atmospheric ozone lies in the stratosphere (15-35 km).

questions.q: Which of the following pollutants is mainly responsible for acid rain?
options: Sulphur dioxide and oxides of nitrogen
questions.exp: SO2 and NOx form sulphuric and nitric acids, lowering rain pH below 5.6.

questions.q: According to Lindeman's 10 per cent law, how much energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next?
questions.exp: Only about one-tenth of energy is passed to the next trophic level; the rest is lost as heat and respiration.

questions.q: Which of the following is an ex-situ method of conserving biodiversity?
questions.exp: Ex-situ conservation protects species outside their natural habitat, e.g. zoos, botanical gardens, seed banks.

questions.q: The average of five numbers is 24. If one of the numbers, 14, is removed, what is the average of the remaining four?
questions.exp: Sum = 5 x 24 = 120; remaining sum = 106; average = 106/4 = 26.5.

questions.q: A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.exp: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day, so time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.q: A train 150 m long runs at 54 km/h. How long does it take to pass a pole?
A room is 8 m long, 6 m wide and 3 m high. What is the total area of its four walls?
questions.exp: Area of four walls = 2(l + b) x h = 2(8 + 6) x 3 = 84 m².

questions.q: Solve for x: 5(x - 2) = 3x + 6.
Thermometer : Temperature :: Barometer : ?
questions.exp: A thermometer measures temperature; a barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.q: Which of the following is the odd one out?
questions.exp: 64 = 4³, 125 = 5³ and 216 = 6³ are perfect cubes; 144 is not a perfect cube.

questions.q: In a class of 40 students, Anil's rank from the top is 12. What is his rank from the bottom?
questions.exp: Rank from bottom = 40 − 12 + 1 = 29.

questions.q: What is the 8th letter to the left of the 5th letter from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.exp: 5th from the right is V (position 22). 8th to its left is position 22 − 8 = 14, which is N.

questions.q: The 3rd of a month falls on a Thursday. On which day does the 27th of that month fall?
questions.exp: 27 − 3 = 24 days later; 24 mod 7 = 3; Thursday + 3 days = Sunday.
